doc_a.text:
Internal evaluation notes for BrineDB:
- (5/5) BrineDB online DDL completed a 200M-row column add with <2s p99 lock waits in a published bench.
- (4/5) Point-in-time recovery restores to second-level granularity with integrity checks before open.
- (3/5) Read replicas can be promoted with a single documented fence token.

doc_b.text:
Internal evaluation notes for QuartzLake:
- (5/5) QuartzLake analytical queries on 1TB parquet finished under 12s median in an open methodology note.
- (4/5) Storage tiers auto-move cold partitions with query rewrite so SQL stays unchanged.
